scope: First complete main text line, consonants only. Next-line edge traces and vowel/cantillation marks not assigned reference labels.

root_candidate.method: Visual inspection of complete page and native-resolution crop before local canonical/WLC comparison. Root knew the uploader's page range; this is not blind.

local_edition_control.role: Same-codex edition control, not an independent manuscript and not a newly inspected critical apparatus.

independent_image_only_review.qualification: Tentative; reviewer reported ambiguity and insufficient next-line edge material.

decision: Do not freeze a high-confidence glyph answer key or score model character accuracy from this unresolved label. Preserve both readings; no second-model consensus, recovered text or manuscript variant is established.
next_discriminating_step: Check larger native-scale context or an independently established diplomatic control for these glyphs. If the edition reading is adopted as a provisional reference, explicitly justify the visible letter evidence and retain the failed blinded label check; do not obtain repeated votes merely until agreement.
